svg.aria-label: Matrices A, B and C as 8 by 8 grids of cells. A block's 2 by 2 tile of C, highlighted, needs rows 2 and 3 of A and columns 4 and 5 of B. At the step shown, 1 2 by 2 tile of each strip is in shared memory.
svg.text: A block walks its strips of A and B 1 tile at a time.
tile of A at step k0
tile of B at step k0
The block's T × T tile of C needs a strip of T rows of A and a strip of T columns
of B. At each step k0 the block copies 1 T × T tile of each into shared memory;
every value copied is then read by T threads, so global reads fall T times.
